Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × celtica F.M.Vázquez, Coombes, Rodr.-Coombes, S.Ramos & Doncel.

The native range of this hybrid is S. Iberian Peninsula. It is a shrub or tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is Q. lusitanica × Q. suber.
